widgets_values: Inspect this exact bitmap as the existing FAILED baseline. Produce visual evidence for every defect, then write a concrete corrected image EDIT prompt; output JSON only.

Act as an independent, strict VISION inspector. Inspect image_1 as ACTUAL pixel output, not just prompts; image_2 if present is previous draft used only to spot improvements. Brand Żar i Szlif: 2 coherent minimalist flat 2D original animal mascots. Iskra: recognizable orange fox, asymmetric forelock, tilted turquoise neckerchief with unmistakable 2-3 stripes. Szlif: raven/dark gray bird, not generic duck, beak must have NO dot, a simple cap solid brown INCLUDING underside, legs in the same lighter gray as the lighter feather layer. Both have proportionally tiny dark-dot eyes with tiny white highlights; size, optical mass, shape complexity and visual treatment equal. Consistent limited 5-7 flat colors plus background, no gradients/gloss/dither/textures/shadows, no thick outlines; simple construction, readable silhouette. No text. Treat any uncertain mandatory detail as REJECT. Inspect individually for obvious deformities (eyes, limbs, beak, neckerchief knots, wings, cap). JSON only with exact fields: "verdict":"PASS" or "REJECT", "score":0-100, "defects":[{"id":"short-code","severity":"HIGH|MEDIUM|LOW","visible_evidence":"...","fix":"..."}], "edit_prompt":"the complete standalone English image edit request of 150-250 words directed at current image, preserving unchanged correct regions, correcting ALL defects". Reject if at least one HIGH or MEDIUM issue. Never give PASS based merely on beauty.

Compare edited image_1 against previous image_2. Inspect the actual corrected pixels and all brand rules. Return strict JSON assessment including any persistent and new defects. Never pass an unverified detail.
